feedback.message: Treat QNDRF as current leading simplification candidate, but keep dedicated light embedding counterbaseline until matched H1 evidence. Add hierarchical visual-change control and exact feature-version semantics to architecture gap analysis.

Implement matched visual differential around current Qwen3.5/mmproj path; prove single-encode reuse, representation/open-set quality, ROI/context failures, action verification and crash/version behavior.
Research GWT admission using visual uncertainty/novelty/action-criticality after lower-level change and feature-delta gates; do not equate visual confidence with truth or ignition authority.
Ensure ClayCode can type representation/version identity, visual evidence epochs, semantic-change routing, active sensing and stale-feature rejection without new semantic architecture duplication.
Represent visual prototype/text-anchor relations, source ancestry and feature-version compatibility as derived topology; activation never becomes truth.
Persist exact model/mmproj/quantization/pooling/projection identities for MVC prototypes/caches and reject/rebuild incompatible feature epochs.
Keep raw-Qwen, projected-Qwen and dedicated-light-encoder alternatives simultaneously unresolved until matched evidence collapses the branch.
Test whether the added feature-delta layer contributes causal task/resource benefit using lesion/rescue and shuffled/threshold controls; recurrence or correlation alone is not emergence.
q23 is now a discoverable domain_research branch and must enter whole-mesh synthesis when multimodal perception, model selection, GWT, memory or H1/H3 architecture is materially involved.
